mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 10% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and depresses equity prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12M MA and INDPRO YoY < 97% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 6-month moving averages signals increased household spending and savings, which typically precede stronger consumer demand and higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 6M MA and RSAFS > 6M MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in CPIAUCSL below 1.5% for three consecutive months signals a deflationary shock, which increases real interest rates and discourages investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly below zero at 10% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS above 0.4% month-over-month and a decline in UNRATE below 4% signals a softening labor market with stable employment, which typically supports corporate margin expansion and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: transition from tight to balanced labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 5% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in GDPC1 above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for six consecutive months indicates a robust demand expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12M MA and GDPC1 YoY > 102% for six consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly above zero at 10% confidence.
